patches.title: The Rules and Races Overhaul

notes.content: We've redefined all of the basic rules for the system!
notes: Being based on 5e D&D was becoming a bit more confusing than it was worth, especially as it made it more difficult for those unfamiliar with D&D to get into this system. We decided to break away from that basis and strictly define how everything works down to the basics.

The rules section is now separated into 8 categories: Basics, Characters, The Turn, Damage & Conditions, Combat, Environment, and DM Tips. Each category explains the basic concepts within, from which dice to use to the types of actions you can take and more.

We've tried to explain everything, but there's a lot of mechanics in this game and something may have slipped through the cracks. Please let us know if you notice something missing or needing to be corrected!

notes.content: The Races have been reorganized and expanded
notes: We've organized the races into Player and NPC Races. NPC Races aren't technically balanced for Players, but can still be played if your DM allows it.
A number of new Races have been added: Cyborgs, Ghosts, Animals and Rock Animals, Living and Undead Chimera, Living Stands, and Plants

notes.content: Several Classes were tweaked
notes: Ranged-Type and Ability-Type have had their Attack Dice increased (1d6/2d6->1d8/2d6 and 1d4/1d6->1d6/1d8 respectively)
All Stand Types now have a linear progression option that doesn't scale with your Level
All Stand Types now get their Special Ability earlier, and Ability-Type gets Ultimate Ability earlier
All Non-Stand Classes get Equalizer at Level 1 now
Clarified and tweaked how Undead and Pillar Men take extra damage from The Ripple
Level-Up tables were updated slightly for: Ability, Artisan, Assassin, Consul, Enhancement, Heavyweight, Ranged, Ranger, Ripple, Scholar

notes.content: Some new Abilities were added, largely for the new Races
notes: Bionic Enhancements, Bound Powers, Chimeric Nature, Chimera Pools, Intangible Form, Living Stand Nature, Mobile Haunt, Pillar Man's Physique, Poltergeist Powers, Puppeteer Powers, Revenant Powers, Rooted Defense, Sacrifice Bionics, Stand Pools, Stationary Haunt, Sunshield, Supernatural Roots, Chimeric Undeath

notes.content: Ranged Attack and Melee Barrage were reworked... again
notes: They now allow you to choose how many Attacks to spend on them, rather than consuming your entire Action. Spending more Attacks results in more damage, but if you wish you can use some of your Attacks for something else (like Defensive Ability, etc).

notes.content: Some new Feats were added
notes: Beastial Cunning: Gives more Intelligence/Charisma to Animals
Familiar Synergy: Gives you a special combination move for you and your Familiar to use
Rallying Cry: A support ability that lets you share HP and Temp HP with allies

Swift Recovery: Gives a pool of recoverable Hit Points
Wrestler: Improves the ability to Grapple and Shove

notes.content: Natural Talent and Perfected Craft were removed
notes: These Feats became redundant since all Proficiences now stack according to the redefined rules. Most instances of their gain have been replaced with Practical Experience or Jack of All Trades.
For similar reasons, Spin Expertise and Spin Mastery were also removed, instead just replaced with a simple Proficiency gain on the Level-Up table

notes.content: A few important balance changes!
notes: Stands can use their Damage Reduction on damage from some physical Saving Throws now
Charmed creatures can have a free Charisma Check made against them each Turn
Familiar can't be killed unless their owner dies
Melee Barrage was nerfed slightly, no longer able to use Stand stats for the DC

notes.content: A number of small but important clarifications

notes.content: Equalizer is a way to allow those without a Stand to have a better chance of fighting a Stand User, letting them apply pressure even with mundane weapons
notes: Anyone with a Supernatural Item (Non-Super Variant Rule) gains this, as does Remote and Revenge Type
Substand expert lets you briefly use a Stand even while the other is summoned/active, similar to the use of Epitaph and King Crimson in canon

notes.content: New Act-Type page in the Editor
notes: Act-Type Stands function very differently from others, having essentially 3-4 separate Stands with unique stats and Abilities. Because of this, they never worked very well within the Editor. To correct this, we've now added another page just for them.

notes.content: This new page contains space for all of your Act's stats and info in one place, and only shows up when "Act" is selected as your class.
notes: This does mean that it won't work for multiclassing. I may consider having the page show up when the "Other/Multiclass" option is selected, but for the time being I don't think that's necessary. We really don't recommend trying to multiclass or multitype with Act-Type anyway.

It should be noted that we removed support for Act 0 in the sheet, as they don't really have much stat-wise anyway and cease to exist when you get Act 1. We've also added support for Act 4. Because of this, your existing Act data may be shifted over by 1 after this update, but it will all still be there even if it's in the wrong place on the sheet.
This page will be added to the PDF version in its next update, and should be added within roll20 very soon and TTS at some point.

Additionally, when you try to save a character with an expired session the logout button changes back to the login button, so you can log back in without losing your changes.

notes.content: A few optimizations and tweaks to the editor
In the load window, character images are now loaded separately from the other card info, which should greatly improve load times.
notes: While they're loading, you'll just see the default Jotaro-shadow image.

notes.content: Made the process of creating a new folder a bit more intuitive.
notes: Previously, you could only create a folder by attempting to move a character into one that doesn't already exist. While this was fine and explained in the move dialog, it wasn't obvious.

Now, you're able to create a new empty folder by clicking the "+" button that was previously only used to create a new blank character. This button now has a small context menu that allows you to choose between creating a new character or folder.
Folders created this way are simply named "New Folder" by default (or New Folder 1, 2, 3, etc), but can be renamed of course.
Made a few other smaller optimizations and visual tweaks.
A few other small fixes.

notes.content: Editor Folders!
notes: That's right, you can now organize your characters in the editor into distinct folders!
Folders can be nested inside each other, moved, renamed, duplicated, and deleted just like characters.
Moving, duplicating, or deleting a folder logically applies those operations to its contents as well.
This *shouldn't* break any existing functionality, but it's a pretty big structural change so let me know if you encounter any issues.

notes.content: Slightly rephrased the Account Recovery page within the editor

notes.content: Added logic to check for an updated version of the website
notes: This should allow you to get the latest changes right away, rather than having to wait for your cache to expire or hard reload the page
This may or may not work for this update since your cache might be missing the change that makes this possible, but it should work for every future update

notes.content: A huge first step towards translating our module into more languages has been completed, as Mini has helped us translate the entire character sheet editor into Ukrainian!
notes: For those interested, relevant pages will now have a small toggle in the upper-right (bottom-right of the menu on mobile) to change the language, with "uk" now being one of the options. When chosen, the page will reload and all text on the page should be translated to the chosen language.

This shouldn't break any functionality, or break any pages that don't yet have translations available, but it's been a pretty clunky learning process so please let me know if you encounter any problems. As a reminder, you may need to hard reload (ctrl+f5) or open in incognito to see the changes immediately.

We'll soon be working to translate more of the website into Ukrainian, and more languages will hopefully be on the way as well! I've heard from at least one person working on helping us translate to Russian for sure.
If you'd also wish to help translate our website, reach out to Xenotater!

patches.title: The Modular Update

notes.content: The Modular Update!
notes: Every Class now has a variant level-up table that allows for more varied options when building your character
This system is a Variant Rule, and it's up to the DM if it should be used

notes.content: New Skills
notes: The 5e Skills system doesn't quite fit the settings commonly seen in JoJo's, so we've made some changes to most of the Skills to make them fit better.
Descriptions of these Skills as well as a guide on how to convert from the 5e versions is in the Rules section
The Character Sheet was updated to include these new Skills

notes.content: Act-Type was reworked
notes: Even the non-modular version of the Class is more open and versatile now

notes.content: Touched up the layout of the Weapons page

There's now a list of all the weapon attributes below the table, so you can look for a specific attribute rather than trying to find a weapon with it and hovering over it in the list. The tooltips in the list itself still work as well of course.

notes.content: Number of Feats is now equal to your Proficiency Bonus

notes.content: Some more small clarifications

notes.content: New Undead Ability - Spider Climb

notes.content: We have a Patreon!

notes.content: Unstoppable Willpower was tweaked
notes: This Feat now has a a lower minimum DC of 10, but can only be used an amount of times equal to your PB per Long Rest
A few more small tweaks, fixes, and clarifications

notes.content: Fixed a number of editor layout issues in Safari for iOS users
notes: Safari has a number of compatability issues compared to other browsers and there might still be issues here and there, but I fixed several major ones.
Fixed a small edge-case logic error with the new act functionality in the editor

notes.content: Added a privacy policy to keep us GDPR compliant
notes: This is just for adsense in the EU. You can check it if you'd like, there's a link at the bottom of the home page, but it's mostly a bunch of legal speak.

Overall, the only personal data we collect about you is your username, password, and email if you have an account in the editor, and your site usage and very general location through Google Analytics. We do nothing with this data other than track analytics, serve ads, and send password recovery emails.

notes.content: Made Act-Types work in the editor
notes: When you select the 'act' class, a number will appear next to it representing each of the acts (0-3)
Depending on which is selected, the respective multipliers will be applied to the autofill logic

For existing act stands, they'll load up with their old scores in the act 0 layout. You'll have to manually move them to the correct act. The other layouts will he autofilled based on the user stats, you'll want to add the levelup points to these.
This *might* break some peoples stand scores if you had them in the wrong format or wrong boxes. Please let me know if unexpected behavior occurs.

notes.content: Made a small tweak to the new Melee Barrage rules
notes: It now consumes your Reaction as well
This is to balance out how much we buffed it, allowing the high, multi-hit, DR ignoring damage but making it a risker play and preventing opportunity attacks / reaction abilites
This Ability has been.. surprisingly difficult to balance. We'd rather not have to rework it again, but feel free to let us know if you have thoughts on the matter.

patches.title: The Here-And-There Rework

notes.content: Passions were given a fresh coat of paint
notes: Most Passions get more Proficiencies now, and some had their ABIs tweaked
The Traveler Passion was removed, and a new Passion, Warrior, was added

notes.content: Artifacts were revisited
notes: These hadn't been updated since we started putting things together several years ago, and a few tweaks were needed
The largest changes are new variants of Conductive Clothing, the addition of Imperfect Ajas, and the way Requiem is obtained was changed slightly

notes.content: Non-Supernatural Classes were buffed/tweaked slightly
notes: Overall just made them more consistent, ensuring they get something new every other level

notes.content: A number of Class Features were updated, be sure to check all of yours!
notes: In particular, Melee Barrage was finally buffed (we nerfed it far too hard), Ranged Attack (Burst) deals half damage on success, and a number of Ripple Abilities were made less expensive
Additionally, a new Ability, Nemesis, was added for Revenge-Types

notes.content: Two new Feats were added, Sentient Stand and Shared Stand
notes: These were added to more accurately represent a few unique Stand types seen in canon

notes.content: Clarified and tweaked Substands and Multi-Type Stands slightly
notes: Hit Dice now alternate per Level, rather than forcing you to take the first/lower Hit Die

notes.content: A few general rules were tweaked
notes: Specified that Unarmed Strikes do not add Dex to damage, only to-hit
Time/Space Abilities no longer always cost double SE, Ability cost may be tweaked at DM discretion for particularly powerful ones
The average may be taken when rolling for Stand stat increases on Level-Up (5 + Level for most types, 8 + Level for Revenge)
A number of small clarifications/typo fixes as usual

notes.content: The Hospitality Worker Passion was updated based on suggestions by Silver Foxy
notes: Be sure to leave your own suggestions in the #suggestions channel of our Discord, we read them all!

notes.content: A limit of 10 has been placed on the maximum number of Attacks per round
notes: Even 10 is a lot, and would require a speed of 450. Anything more than that would be excessive and take far too long to roll for one turn.

notes.content: Melee Barrage was simplified
notes: Now limited to only 5 attacks, the number of which is HALF your Speed Modifier
However, you get to add your Power Modifier once, AND the Damage Dice upgrades at level 11
Partially a buff, partially a nerf. This change is intended to make Melee Barrages easier and take less time.

notes.content: Ranged Attack was buffed
notes: The number of Damage Dice are now doubled at Level 11, as well as the range like before

notes.content: Assassin was buffed
notes: This was actually a mistake in the last update, it should've been d8s, rather than d6s

notes.content: Whirlwind Attacker was buffed
notes: The forced Save option now MUST be a Dex Save, rather than allowing Precision to be used
Additionally, half damage is taken on success

notes.content: Fixed several small typos and errors
notes: Notably the Hive-Type table had Stand Pickpocketing in two places
Also Improved Slippery was missing a limit, it can only be used twice per Short Rest

patches.title: The High-Level Stand Overhaul

notes.content: The High-Level Stand Overhaul!
notes: Stand Users now gain additional Class Features for Levels 15-20
This includes some new Abilities, and some were removed or changed for simplification.
Every Stand Type has been tweaked slightly, be sure to look over your level-up tables!

Some Stand Types have had tweaks to their stat multipliers (Ranged, Revenge, Hive, and Act). If you'd like to update these on an existing character, you'll need to know both the new and old multipliers. For this purpose, the previous version of the document can be found at <https://www.jojodnd.com/resources/Assets/PDFs/JoJo_D&D_v1.8.1.pdf>

notes.content: Ripple and Spin have been given an additional ASI at Level 17
notes: This is to match the additional ASI added to Stand Users in this rework

notes.content: The Assassin and Suit Stand Feats have been tweaked slightly
notes: Assassin now clarifies that it can be used on attacks and weapons with Ambush, and Advantage isn't required if an Ally is within melee of your target
Suit Stand now also grants the Anchored Stand Ability

notes.content: A new weapon was added, the Boomerang!
notes: It comes with a new weapon attribute which of course allows it to return to you after being thrown
Menacing Aura was nerfed slightly, preventing it from being spammed

notes.content: The formatting of level-up tables was tweaked
notes: The delimiting comma was replaced by a pipe (|) to prevent confusion between automatic Features and choices
A number of spelling/grammar fixes were also made
Reworded the text on the Community Resources button to be more clear
Removed any discord discriminators since they're mostly not a thing anymore
Fixed some spelling errors within several feats
Changed the image representing Non-Supernatural classes

notes.content: The Graceful Ripple Fighting Style was tweaked
notes: In addition to how it already functioned, you can now use Unarmed Dice with Simple Melee Weapons if desired.
Ranged Type Stands are given the option to take Immense Power at level 1

notes.content: Hive type Ability Scores are no longer dependant on the number of Instances
notes: This was a neat idea to make each individual Instance weaker on its own, but in practice it was far to clunky, requiring mental division moment-to-moment during gameplay.

notes.content: Fixed a link that was broken in the last update
notes: (PDF Version only)

notes.content: Made older versions of the module available on the Resources page (PDF versions only)
notes: I'm not making a custom page layout for this so it's just the ugly raw html directory but they're there.
Fixed some typos and capitalization inconsistencies

patches.title: The Ripple & Spin Rework

notes.content: The Ripple & Spin Rework!
notes: The Ripple and Spin classes have both been overhauled, buffing them up to be more on-par with Stand Users.
Be sure to look over all of your Class Features to see what's changed!
Not happy with the changes and/or have suggestions? Let us know!
Brought the document up to date with several smaller changes already present on the website
Clarified Undead Feeding rules, fixed a few references to removed/renamed content, fixed some typos, etc.

notes.content: Clarified Undead Feeding rules
notes: Ghouls, Vampires, and EPMs can consume energy from a willing or incapacitated target, draining up to 2 energy as an Action (or 5 for EPMs).
Fixed a few references to removed/renamed content

notes.content: Fixed even MORE capitalization and grammar issues and inconsistencies
notes: Most of these fixes won't make their way to the pdf doc unless by chance, I just don't feel like combing through that
Updated the link to the pdf doc for v1.7.0
Tidied up a few things

patches.title: The Undead Rework

notes.content: The Undead Rework!
notes: Many things relating to the Undead races have been simplified or buffed.
Racial features were simplified, level-ups are less restrictive and cost less energy, Ghouls get levels, and more!
If you have an Undead character, be sure to check the Races page to see what's changed for you!
In addition to the Undead races, Ultimate Beings, Pillar Men, and Abominations were also tweaked to differing degrees
The Headhunter Feat has also been tweaked

notes.content: Melee Barrage was tweaked slightly to take Undead creatures' increased damage dice into account
notes: 40d8 damage from an EPM Stand User is just too much

notes.content: Buffed the Suit Stand Feat, it now also raises Stand physical stat multipliers by 2
notes: For example, a Power-Type typically has x4, x3, x3 for Power, Precision, and Durability. The Suit Stand Feat would raise this to x6, x5, and x5 respectively.

notes.content: Tried to make the capitalization of certain more consistent across the site
notes: We're not perfect and don't have a proper 'editor', so if you notice any grammatical errors on the site or document please take note of them and let us know!
Tweaked some confusing wording in a few places
Fixed a logic issue with the editor's autofill for Stand stat multiplication caused by the toggle added in v1.6.0.1

notes.content: Fixed an issue with sorting by Class on the Abilities page
notes: Fixed a subsequent issue with searching on the Abilities page caused by the above fix...
Fixed a small visual issue with the editor on Firefox
Fixed an edge case spacing issue in the Weapons table

notes.content: A new Feat, Suit Stand, has been added.
notes: This Feat is inspired by Stands such as White Album and Oasis. It restricts Range and makes the Stand physically tangible, but in exchange allows the Stand to become stronger in ways not typically possible for that Stand Type.
Let us know what cool Stands you come up with relating to this in the Stand-Ideas channel on our Discord server!
Since this is a minor update, a new version of the Doc won't be published with this yet, but the new Feat is visible live on the site.

notes.content: Made a number of compatability fixes for Safari users
notes: A number of tables with custom scrolling (passions, abilities, feats, familiars) were behaving unexpectedly on Safari
I was unaware of this and unable to troubleshoot it since I do not own an Apple device, but the problems should be fixed now
Please let me know if you notice any other issues while viewing our site on Safari (or use a better browser :p)
Tweaked some wording with new Familiar content

notes.content: Added a password recovery feature to the editor
notes: In order to authenticate users for this, new users will need to provide their email during registration.
Current users will be asked to enter their email upon logging in without one in our system, but this isn't mandatory.

notes.content: Added a toggle to the editor to flip which box the scores and modifiers go in
notes: This setting should be saved alongside your character, let me know if you notice any issues with it.

notes.content: New Familiar System!
notes: Partner up with your favorite animal companion and give them their own class and even a stand!
Information about this system can be found on a new main nav page: <https://www.jojodnd.com/familiars>

notes.content: Feats Rework
notes: A number of Feats have been reworked, buffing most of them and overall making things more interesting an better balanced.
Some Feats were also renamed. Cleave is now Whirlwind Attacker, Evasive is now Specialized Save, and Hidden Assassin is now just Assassin.
Natural Toughness and Toxin Resistance were removed.
Be sure to check the Feats page to see if any of yours have been changed!

notes.content: Fixed a massive security flaw in how php files were being handled.
notes: As far as we are aware, no user data was or could have been compromised.
Improved the performance of the character loader in the editor by adding pages to it rather than trying to pull all of the data at once

notes.content: Added a Community Resources page
notes: Feel free to reach out to me if you want your own work featured on the site!
Made a few things more responsive
Added a new item to the rules section, Speed Duels

notes.content: Fixed a few typos and improved clarity in some areas
notes: The explanation for Multi-Type stands was outdated and has been corrected.

notes.content: The Weapons have be overhauled!
notes: This includes the addition of new weapons, removal of redundant weapons, and the refactoring of all weapon attributes. Check your arsenal for changes!
A number of weapons that were in the old table weren't included in this overhaul. For the most part this is because they can be found in base 5e, so you can just use those.
Some of the other weapons were too complex or niche for our general list, but DMs are encouraged to homebrew interesting and unique weapons using the examples and attributes we've created.
Some additions may be made to the list at a later time to fill it out more if needed.

notes.content: Some Feats that were no longer needed or were replaced have been removed.
notes: This includes Simple Weapon Proficiency, Weapon Master, Pistol Proficiency, Rifle Proficiency, Heavy Weapon Specialist, Unarmed Proficiency, Thrown Weapon Proficiency, Automatic Weapon Proficiency, Martial Weapon Proficiency, Close Combat Specialist, Shield Master

notes.content: Updated some class level up lists with the new feats
notes: The Non-Supernatural classes have been particularly affected by this. However, Remote, Ability, and Revenge type Stands have also been slightly affected.

notes.content: The PDF version of the module has finally been updated!
notes: We've made changes to the document to more closely reflect changes on the website, please let us know if anything seems to be missing in this regard.
We've also done our best to make the formatting more consistent.

notes.content: Website tweaks
notes: Fixed some typos and clarified a few things
Made a number of background changes to improve site performance
Made some small changes to improve SEO
Tweaked Scarflesh, Stoneflesh, and Catlike Agility
Replaced the old description for summoning a Revenge Stand, which should've been removed in the last update
Fixed a couple of typos

patches.title: The Revenge-Type Rework

notes.content: Made massive changes to Revenge-Types, if you play a Revenge-Type, make sure you look over the Class features and Abilities so you know what's changed!
notes: Revenge Stands are no longer summoned through pure, flat damage. Instead, a new system called Grudge Points has been implemented.
Replaced the Unconscious Control feature with Lasting Grudge
Reworked Near-Death Escape and reworded Second Life
Added an optional Feat for Revenge-Types, Guardian's Wrath
Since these changes greatly affect how the class plays, some tweaks may be made to them in the near future as we work to properly balance things
Added a new rule involving Stand Users and Surprise
Nerfed the Dagger slightly and added a new weapon (Clackers)

notes.content: Made changes to a number of Feats and added a several new ones
notes: Changed Feats include: Art of Distraction, Calculating, Immense Impact, Light Sleeper, Paranoia, Quick on your Feet
New Feats include: Exemplar, Guerilla Fighter, Heavy Sleeper, Perfected Craft, Skirmisher
Added a new Passion (Leader)

notes.content: Fixed some typos and made a few things more clear
notes: This includes an "a.k.a." subtitle for each stand type

notes.content: Refactored the code for the editor to make things more clean and clear
notes: This shouldn't affect user experience in any way
Fixed an alignment issue when renaming a character
Fixed a niche issue where duplicating character info contianing `'`s would fail

patches.title: The Hive-Type Rework

notes.content: Made massive changes to Hive Types, if you play a Hive Type, make sure you look over the Class Features and Abilities so you know what's changed!
notes: Instance Levels were removed, you may now choose at Level 1 an amount between 2 and 500
All level up options that increased Instance Level now give other options (1, 4, 5, 7, 12, and 14).
Split Stand was clarified and changed slightly
Swarm Attack was completely revamped
Hive Types now gain 2d4 + Level each Level Up, rather than 1d4 + Level
Hive Types can now increase their Durability, there are no stat restrictions for this Type anymore
Special Ability now costs 2 SE as usual, rather than 3

notes.content: Improved the security of how user passwords are stored
notes: This *shouldn't* affect your experience logging in as the change should be handled on the backend when you next log in
If you happen to notice any issues with this, please let me know ASAP
Fixed a rare issue where the anchor ad would appear at the top of the page instead of the bottom and break the navbar's placement
Renamed Embryo Implantation (Vampire Feature) to Primal Offspring and completely reworded it
Fixed an error in the editor that would preserve Saving Throw proficiencies between characters
Fixed a very obscure formatting issue on the editor
Fixed various small typos that caused broken links
Fixed wide images breaking the image box on character sheets
Moved the editor's login button and made it much more obvious
Improved button spacing for mobile and wider desktops
Tidied up a few things on the main page and navbar
Added ads to the site to support hosting costs, our goal is for these to be as non-intrusive as possible so please let us know if you have any issues with their placement/content.
Added a new mechanic relating to stand energy, 1 SE is now regained when you take the dodge action.
Added an 'other' option to the class box in the editor, for those multiclassing.
Fixed some math/logic errors when calculating stand stat changes.
Fixed some php handling in the editor and made some error messages more helpful.
Implemented some better security for character data that gets saved to the database.
Fixed character images stretching/squishing in the load menu and made a few other small visual tweaks.
Fixed a number of typos and grammatical errors on the main, rules, and passions pages. More to come soon, let us know if you spot any!
You can now create an account and save your characters on the website, rather than needing to import/export data or recreate it everytime. Your sheets are now accessible from anywhere!
The import/export options still exist, for those who want to use them or for sharing your sheets with others.
The overall layout and functionality of the editor has been improved.
Ranged Attack has been almost completely changed for balance and flavor purposes
Rules for Substands have been added to the Stands page
A new Feat inspired by Speedwagon has been added, The Commentator
Immense Impact was added to the Feats page on the site, it was previously missing
The Editor will now autofill stand scores when increasing/decreasing ability scores based on the multiplier for your stand type
One more change was just made to the Deadly Accuracy Feat as well, we didn't realize that our changes to Ranged Attack kinda broke it.
Passions have been buffed slightly to give more proficiencies, check the website for more details.

notes.content: You can now import/export character data files in the editor, allowing you to edit the character later without having to start from scratch.
notes: This solution isn't the slickest, and at some point I'll probably implement some form of account-based server-side saving, but it'll do for now.
This should help those of you who can't print out the PDF version, as you can essentially use the editor like an online character sheet.

notes.content: It took less time than I expected honestly, there's now a Character Sheet Editor on the website! Check it out at: <https://www.jojodnd.com/resources/editor/>
notes: If you find any issues with the editor, please let me know and I'll fix it as soon as I can!

notes.content: After 3 months of working on it, the official JoJo's Bizarre Tabletop Game website is live!
notes: This site aims to make the information on the module more easy to access and navigate. All the information is imported now, and several more features are planned including an editable character sheet, stat screen creator, popup info when hovering over links, and more!
The module document has been updated and polished after significant playtesting
Work on the website has begun
First "complete" version of the document complete.

patches.title: The Beginning
notes: Work on the module first began
